guidebook.intro: Hobbies and sport. **Ma asi muke … si** (my heart is glad with …) is “I enjoy”.

tips.title: Ma asi muke … si
body: **Ma asi muke buku ali si** (I enjoy reading). **Ma le ongo** (I like music).
**o’be** is play: **Ma o’be mupira** (I play football).

tips.title: Goli!
body: **Ama timu ega ra!** (our team has won!), **A’di ega ra?** (who has won?), **Ama ru ra** (we lost).
**Ongo** is both song and dance: **ongo ngo** sing, **ongo to** dance.

culture.title: Football
body: Football is played in every school field in West Nile, and the Uganda Cranes draw crowds around every radio and TV.
